question: who inaugurated and addressed the 85th All India Presiding officers' Conference in Patna, Bihar, on 20 January 2025 as Speaker of | the Lok Sabha ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Om Birla**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Om Birla**, the current **Speaker of the Lok Sabha**, inaugurated and addressed the **85th All India Presiding Officers' Conference** on **20 January 2025** in **Patna, Bihar**.
 
• The **All India Presiding Officers' Conference** is a crucial gathering of legislative leaders aimed at discussing parliamentary practices, procedures, and challenges.
 
• Om Birla has been serving as the **Speaker of the Lok Sabha** since **2019**. His tenure is marked by efforts to enhance parliamentary productivity and ensure smooth functioning of the House.
 
• The conference in **Patna** brought together **presiding officers** from across India to deliberate on issues like legislative integrity, transparency, and cooperation between the Union and state legislatures.
 
• Om Birla emphasized the importance of adopting modern technologies to improve parliamentary processes and enhance participation in governance.
 
• The **85th All India Presiding Officers' Conference** also focused on ways to increase public trust in legislative institutions and promote democratic values.
 
• This conference is a continuation of the tradition of presiding officers coming together to exchange ideas and address challenges faced in legislative functioning.
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is Om Birla.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Om Birla:**

 
 
• **Om Birla**, born on **23 November 1962**, hails from **Kota, Rajasthan**. He has been actively involved in politics as a member of the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)**.
 
• He was elected as the **Member of Parliament (MP)** from **Kota-Bundi constituency**, Rajasthan.
 
• Om Birla was unanimously elected as the **17th Speaker of the Lok Sabha** on **19 June 2019**.
 
 
 
• **All India Presiding Officers' Conference:**
 
 
• The conference is an annual event that brings together **speakers, deputy speakers, and other presiding officers** of parliamentary and legislative bodies in India.
 
• It serves as a platform to discuss **parliamentary practices, legislative reforms, and challenges** faced by legislatures.
 
• The conference also aims to promote **coordination between the Union and state legislatures** and enhance democratic governance.
 
 
 
• **Patna, Bihar:**
 
 
• **Patna**, the capital city of Bihar, is historically significant for hosting political and intellectual discussions, including legislative events.
 
• It is a hub for political activities and has hosted several important conferences and gatherings over the years.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Significance of the Speaker of the Lok Sabha:**

 
 
• The **Speaker** is the presiding officer of the Lok Sabha and plays a crucial role in maintaining decorum and order during parliamentary proceedings.
 
• The Speaker ensures unbiased functioning of the House and represents the Lok Sabha to the President and other constitutional authorities.
 
 
 
• **Role of Presiding Officers:**
 
 
• Presiding officers, such as the Speaker and Deputy Speaker, are responsible for upholding parliamentary rules and ensuring effective legislative discussions.
 
• They play a key role in bridging differences among political parties and facilitating consensus on important legislative matters.
